annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same decision-relevant evidence for monitoring and escalation: they track due dates/status/owners and the external dependency (OPS04-C1), watch for signs the deadline item, quality issue, or dependency are not on track (OPS04-C2), and route concerns to the relevant owner while continuing to monitor (OPS04-C3). The added detail in C is not materially different, and A/B/C all share the same general approach of seeking a bit more information before escalating without changing the core operational commitment.
